svg.title: boxrunner bench: idle jobs leave the main job's speed alone
svg.desc: On a 4-core ARM VPS the job takes 428 ms alone, 429 ms beside four busy idle-priority jobs and 2.10 s beside four busy normal-priority jobs. On a 4-core x86 VPS it takes 1.39 s alone, 1.44 s beside idle jobs and 6.91 s beside normal jobs.
